purpose: Explicit adaptive development on all consumed data; no independent qualification or new empirical recordings.

frontend.identity_scope: Verified same pinned models, range50-1000Hz,10ms grid and local-statistic RMS floor.01; historical gate choices differ but raw predictors remain compatible. Reject unlisted code_version/params_hash.

fit.standardization: weighted train-only mean/std; variance exactly0 gives scale1
fit.objective: weighted mean BCE + .01/2 * squared coefficient norm; free intercept
fit.calibration: 3-fold singer-OOF base logits; weighted mean BCE of sigmoid(a*logit+b) + .001/2*(a-1)^2; a>=0, free b; then refit base on full allowed training partition
fit.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B; analytic gradient; start base all0, Platt(a,b)=(1,0); require success and finite parameters
fit.labels: reference->native nearest mapping using original scorer tolerance.005001 and earlier ties; unknown excluded; duplicate labels aggregate voiced fraction with count weight; target voicing not pitch correctness
fit.weights: each singer mass1, equal excerpts then 3 singing conditions; each negative family mass1, equal unique rendered inputs, repeated copies split input mass; within stream normalize mapped admissible annotation counts; omit streams with zero admissible labels; no class balancing; normalize total mass

admissibility: force U only for exact source_rms==0, nonfinite/nonpositive candidate, or center outside real input bounds; missing local evidence is a predictor, not a veto; malformed required diagnostics fail
purge: at every fit/calibration/selector level exclude held singers, exact rendered audio hashes, and negative families of validation rows; inherit all ancestor exclusions. Backing family=(recording SHA,window start); silence one family across lengths. Family purge applies to negative rows, not all singing mixtures using same backing.

cross_validation.inner_assignment: sort remaining singer ids numerically and assign round-robin; all excerpts/conditions of a singer stay together
cross_validation.nesting: outer training ->3-fold profile selection; each selector-training pipeline itself uses3-fold OOF logits for Platt, then refits base. After profile selection refit calibrated pipeline on outer training; never use outer labels at any stage.

decoder.transitions: subtract fixed penalty per state switch; no pitch-jump term
decoder.ties: U predecessor on ties and U final on tie
decoder.output: V uses unchanged raw candidate pitch; U givesNaN; no pitch interpolation or clock changes

selection: profiles must satisfy unchanged gates separately in every historical group represented in pooled selector OOF. Rank max minimum RPA over groups/conditions, min maximum FA over the three singing conditions, smaller switch penalty, larger threshold. If none eligible choose fixed(.5,0) for complete diagnostics and record failure; do not expand grid.
advancement: complete outer OOF must pass original gates separately on all3 full historical groups; final selection using same3-fold procedure on all17 singers must be eligible; unchanged pitch-engine analytic controls must retain passing hash-bound evidence. These inherited controls bypass vocal identification and do not validate learned voicing on analytic tones. Outer fallback status explicit; final fallback cannot advance.
probability_diagnostics: outer OOF base and Platt Brier/logloss/fixed10-bin reliability by condition; exact annotation-level Brier for softlabels is y*(1-p)^2+(1-y)*p^2; show admissibility coverage and unmatched counts. Viterbi decisions are not calibrated probabilities.
stop_rule: One frozen9-profile family. Preserve all failures; if advancement criteria fail stop this experiment without grid expansion or fresh data. No new qualification recordings in this development run.
limitations: only two known accompaniment recordings; no unseen-backing generalization claim
adaptive design informed by prior outcomes
probabilities describe specified benchmark weighting, not population prevalence
selection_structural_absence: Only inner selector gates for backing/silence with zero eligible validation rows after ancestor family purge are marked not_tested:ancestor_family_purge and omitted, never counted as passed. Any present control rows must satisfy original gate. Undefined metrics or missing artifacts fail. OuterOOF must include all90 rows/all5conditions/3groups.
